title: First CIA director on the NICAP board

tellings.quote: He was the first CIA director, Navy Admiral and he was on the board of directors for New Fork.

plain: Roscoe Hillenkoetter, a Navy admiral who was the first director of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, is said to have sat on the board of directors of NICAP, a private civilian group that looked into UFO reports in the 1950s and 60s. The researcher Dylan Borland mentions this without naming a source. He tells it to show that a man from the top of US intelligence took part in a group pressing for answers on UFOs.
